text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both up modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite the broader market still in extreme fear. Bitcoin dominance at 57.9% and total volume at $55B indicate a cautious, low-conviction environment where buyers are testing levels but not committing aggressively. The Fear & Greed index at 11 and barely moving over a week points to persistent pessimism with little shift in underlying sentiment.
